summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly release on new residential construction statistics for August 2022 (issued September 20, 2022). Relevant to the task: It provides the Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rates (SAAR) for total building permits (1,517,000), housing starts (1,575,000), and housing completions (1,342,000) needed for the August 2022 market health score. As an initial report, these figures are preliminary and subject to revision by subsequent releases in the collection (e.g., October 2022 report may contain revised August data), adhering to the 'most recent report prevails' rule. It covers only the start month of the 2022/08–2025/05 period, leaving the majority of the timeline unaccounted for in this document.

It covers the start of the task period but lacks data for 2023 through 2025.
